title: SAP ABAP Developer with BRIM
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a SAP ABAP Developer with BRIM based in India.**
This is a senior technical opportunity to develop and evolve enterprise billing and revenue management solutions using SAP BRIM and ABAP.
  
  
You’ll work across Subscription Order Management, Convergent Invoicing, Convergent Charging, and FI-CA.
  
  
The role combines hands-on development, systems integration, performance optimization, testing, and production support.
  
  
You’ll translate complex business and functional requirements into scalable technical solutions for subscription- and usage-based billing models.
  
  
You’ll collaborate with architects, functional consultants, integration teams, finance stakeholders, and infrastructure specialists.
  
  
The position offers exposure to large-scale enterprise transformation initiatives and high-volume billing environments.
  
  
It is well suited to an experienced SAP professional who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and delivering reliable, business-critical solutions.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Design, develop, enhance, and support SAP BRIM technical solutions across SOM, CI, CC, and FI-CA.
* Develop custom ABAP enhancements, interfaces, workflows, forms, APIs, and automation solutions supporting billing and revenue management processes.
* Translate business and functional requirements into scalable, maintainable, and secure technical solutions.
* Develop and enhance SAP Subscription Order Management processes, including order capture, contract modifications, fulfillment integrations, and subscription lifecycle workflows.
* Build APIs and integrations supporting order orchestration, provisioning, and subscription management.
* Develop and support Convergent Charging configurations and customizations covering usage-based billing, rating logic, mediation, pricing, and charging frameworks.
* Optimize charging and transaction processing performance in high-volume environments.
* Develop and support Convergent Invoicing functionality, including billing aggregation, invoice generation, formatting, reconciliation, financial postings, and billing automation.
* Develop and support FI-CA solutions covering customer account management, payment processing, collections, dunning, financial postings, disputes, and account reconciliation.
* Support integration between SAP FI-CA, S/4HANA Finance, and other enterprise systems.
* Develop ABAP programs, BADIs, user exits, enhancements, RFCs, OData services, APIs, and web services.
* Design and support integrations between SAP BRIM and S/4HANA, CRM/CX platforms, middleware, integration platforms, and third-party billing or payment systems.
* Collaborate with integration architects and middleware teams on interface design and implementation.
* Plan and execute unit, integration, system, and user acceptance testing.
* Troubleshoot defects, perform debugging and root-cause analysis, and resolve technical issues.
* Analyze application performance and optimize billing, charging, and transaction-processing efficiency.
* Participate in deployments, cutovers, maintenance windows, incident response, and production support activities.
* Create and maintain technical specifications, interface documentation, operational procedures, development standards, and technical runbooks.
* Ensure solutions comply with enterprise development standards, security requirements, and governance processes.
* Collaborate with SAP BRIM architects, functional consultants, data migration teams, BASIS administrators, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders.
* Participate in architecture reviews, technical design sessions, and Agile ceremonies.
* Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and knowledge transfer to internal teams.

* 7–15 years of professional experience, with proven experience supporting enterprise billing and revenue management solutions.
* Strong hands-on experience with SAP BRIM components, including Subscription Order Management (SOM), Convergent Invoicing (CI), Convergent Charging (CC), and FI-CA.
* Strong ABAP development expertise, including enhancements, user exits, BADIs, APIs, OData services, workflows, and integration development.
* Experience supporting subscription-based and usage-based billing processes.
* Practical experience with SAP HANA and SAP S/4HANA integrations.
* Strong knowledge of middleware, APIs, enterprise integration patterns, and third-party system integrations.
* Experience with application performance tuning, debugging, troubleshooting, and production support.
* Strong understanding of SAP architecture, billing and invoicing processes, financial integration concepts, and enterprise application environments.
* Ability to analyze complex technical problems and develop effective, scalable solutions.
* Strong software development and debugging capabilities with a focus on solution quality and operational stability.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong ability to translate business requirements into clear technical designs and implementations.
* Excellent organizational and documentation skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent relevant experience may also be considered.
* SAP certifications in ABAP, SAP BRIM, SAP HANA, or S/4HANA are preferred.
* Experience with SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite, SAP Fiori, SAP Datasphere, cloud-native SAP deployments, DevOps, or CI/CD methodologies is an advantage.
* Experience in utilities, telecommunications, transportation, finance, or other subscription-based industries is a plus.
* Experience with large-scale enterprise transformation programs and Agile or hybrid delivery methodologies is desirable.
* Prior consulting or contract experience within enterprise SAP environments is beneficial.
* SAP BTP and cloud certifications such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud certifications are additional advantages.

**Benefits**

* Annual compensation of INR 4,500,000–5,500,000.
* Full-time employment with a long-term professional opportunity.

* Opportunity to work on enterprise-scale SAP BRIM, billing, and revenue management initiatives.

title: Director of Software Architecture
description:
Would you like to join a team working across the software technology components used by hundreds of millions of users across multiple platforms and market segments globally? As a Software Architect in the Software Organisation, you will work with our key software ecosystems to define software solutions to enable Arm technology and develop strategies to have those solutions adopted and enabled for users.
  
  
Our Central Engineering Software group delivers support for Arm technologies across a wide variety of software projects and creates example software solutions to demonstrate real world applications. You will join a team of software solution architects addressing the growing demand for software to support Arm systems.
  
  
The position will be based at Arm offices in Cambridge, Budapest, or Bangalore.
  
  
**Job Overview**
As a member of a large software engineering team you will help evolve our software strategy across all computing segments, including data centre, automotive, mobile, robotics, networking, home, laptops, TVs, embedded and IoT. You will drive adoption of new features and trends in core processing, accelerators, and system hardware, focusing on improved security, reliability, and performance.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Understanding new Arm architecture and IP features, their implementation and what that means for existing software components and tools. Devising how to promote their benefits to software ecosystems and resolve issues that arise in their adoption.
* Analysis and deep understanding of software solutions currently deployed in products, in particular the major open-source software projects such as Linux.
* Delivering software improvements back to the relevant open-source projects as a reference for Arm customers to create their own systems from.
* Working with Arm’s OS, OEM and Silicon Partners to drive standards that enable the optimisation, differentiation, and fast evolution benefits of Arm’s Partner model
* Building new software paradigms onto Arm reference hardware designs
* Profiling the performance of the system and innovating ways to improve
* Leading validation of the functionality, security and safety
* You can expect to be working closely with some of the greatest household names in our industry to help develop, optimize, and deliver the software needed to support Arm's pioneering IP, as well as helping Arm grow its role in new market segments.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Knowledge of Arm based computer Architecture and the range of SoCs and devices that are created using Arm hardware IP.
* Experience of software profiling, instrumentation, and optimization for real world applications and workloads such as AI stacks, run-time compilers and multimedia processing.
* Strong understanding of complex multi-component computing systems with demonstrable low-level OS/device driver development or integration experience
* Authoritative knowledge of C or C++ development with proficiency with optimizing applications, workloads, and compilers
* Understanding of how to rigorously test software and design software for test
* Experience of the software lifecycle: has taken complex software from concept to production and maintenance

**Skills**
**“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience :**

* Experience with Android, ChromeOS or Windows software and systems
* Experience with Linux, Linux distributions, Cloud/Edge applications and networking software
* Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence software stacks, algorithms and tooling
* Knowledge of multimedia system designs involving GPUs, compositing display processors and image signal processing
* Familiarity with System-on-a-Chip architectures

Our UK offices are outstanding places to collaborate. If you are interested but unsure whether you tick all the boxes, we still would love you to reach out! We are keen to welcome versatile people into Arm!

title: Software Engineer (AI Training)
description:
**About The Role**
What if the code you write could directly shape how the next generation of AI understands and generates software? We're looking for Software Engineers in Coimbatore to build, evaluate, and improve AI-generated code — helping train AI systems to think like real developers.
  
  
You'll write solutions, review AI outputs, and provide the expert-level feedback that makes AI coding assistants smarter, safer, and more reliable. This is hands-on engineering work at the frontier of AI development — not theoretical, not bureaucratic, and not boring.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. If you can write clean code and explain your reasoning, we want to hear from you.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Write, debug, and optimize code across a range of languages, frameworks, and problem domains
* Review and evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, efficiency, readability, and best practices
* Identify bugs, logic errors, security issues, and performance bottlenecks in AI outputs
* Provide structured, detailed feedback explaining why code works — or doesn't
* Design challenging coding prompts and edge-case scenarios to stress-test AI capabilities
* Compare and rank multiple AI-generated solutions based on engineering quality
* Work independently and asynchronously — fully on your own schedule

**Who You Are**

* Proficient in one or more programming languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, Go, TypeScript, or similar)
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles
* Able to read, write, and reason about code with clarity and precision
* Strong problem-solving instincts and a systematic debugging approach
* Clear written communicator — you can explain technical decisions in plain language
* Self-motivated and reliable when working independently without supervision
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience

**Nice to Have**

* Experience across multiple languages or tech stacks (full-stack, backend, systems, data engineering)
* Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, LLMs, or prompt engineering
* Background in code review, technical writing, or mentoring junior developers
* Experience with cloud platforms, DevOps, or distributed systems
* Competitive programming, open-source contributions, or side projects that demonstrate your craft
* Advanced degree in Computer Science or related discipline

**Why Join Us**

* Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and work from anywhere
* Freelance autonomy with intellectually stimulating, high-impact work
* Directly influence how AI writes, understands, and reasons about code
* Sharpen your own engineering skills by evaluating diverse problems daily
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Research / Senior Research Manager, Weather Data Systems (Weather Initiative)
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Research / Senior Research Manager, Weather Data Systems (Weather Initiative) based in India.**
This role offers the opportunity to build and scale evidence-based weather data systems designed to support smallholder farmers.
  
  
You will help transform real-time scientific forecasts into timely, location-specific guidance that can reach farmers through multiple channels.
  
  
Working across research, technology, program, and dissemination teams, you will connect technical systems with practical field needs.
  
  
The role combines research management, data engineering, system design, quality assurance, and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
You will focus on creating reliable, adaptable infrastructure that can be replicated across geographies and use cases.
  
  
This is a high-impact opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, building scalable systems, and turning technical insights into actionable outcomes.
  
  
The position may be offered at either Research Manager or Senior Research Manager level, depending on experience, seniority, and scope of previous responsibilities.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Work with forecast science, technology, and dissemination teams to design and oversee pipelines that automatically transform real-time scientific forecast data into location-specific farmer messages.
* Develop adaptable systems that can integrate with different dissemination vendors and channels, including voice, SMS, WhatsApp, applications, LLM-powered advisory systems, or combinations of these.
* Ensure time-sensitive forecast information reaches farmers quickly and accurately by reducing processing delays, data transformation latency, and other potential points of failure.
* Own the technical and operational requirements needed to make weather data pipelines replicable across geographies rather than tailored to a single location or use case.
* Bridge technical and non-technical teams by translating forecast science and system constraints into practical requirements for research and program teams, and communicating program needs back to technical stakeholders.
* Oversee data management, quality assurance, testing, and technical rigor as the system expands into new applications and geographies.
* Document system architecture, decision logic, processes, and design rationale so that the infrastructure remains maintainable, auditable, and extensible.
* Coordinate with dissemination teams to ensure automated farmer messages align with standards established through field research.
* Provide technical and data-quality guidance to Associate- and Manager-level colleagues supporting the weather data pipeline.
* Contribute to funding proposals, technical reports, organizational knowledge management, and broader learning related to weather data systems.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in a technical, quantitative, or data-focused discipline such as computer science, data science, engineering, statistics, economics, agricultural economics, or a related field.
* Experience building, managing, or overseeing data pipelines, ideally involving real-time, automated, or continuously processed data.
* Working knowledge of technical tools and programming languages used to build and maintain data systems, such as Python, SQL, or comparable technologies.
* Experience designing systems intended to be replicated, scaled, or adapted across multiple contexts rather than developed as one-off solutions.
* Ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical functions, translating between forecast science, engineering considerations, research requirements, and program priorities.
* Strong research management, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to take ownership and operate proactively in a fast-growing environment.
* Excellent documentation skills and the ability to make technical systems understandable and usable for people who were not involved in building them.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Existing authorization to work in India is required; visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

**Benefits**

This is a senior-level opportunity to shape and evolve an enterprise Identity and Access Management ecosystem across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

The role combines hands-on engineering with strategic architecture across Okta, Active Directory, Entra ID, Google Workspace, and SaaS applications.

**Accountabilities**

* Architect and evolve enterprise IAM strategies across Okta, Active Directory, Entra ID, Google Workspace, SaaS applications, and hybrid or multi-cloud environments.
* Design scalable, secure, and resilient identity solutions while defining IAM standards, reference architectures, patterns, policies, and procedures.

* Strong experience integrating Okta with Active Directory, Entra ID, Google Workspace, and cloud directories within hybrid environments.
* Strong understanding of IAM architecture, identity lifecycle management, access governance, authentication, authorization, and Zero Trust principles.
* Hands-on experience with Okta Universal Directory, SSO, MFA, Adaptive Authentication, Lifecycle Management, Workflows, and Identity Governance.
* Experience with RBAC and ABAC models, privileged access management, access reviews, certifications, and segregation-of-duties controls.
* Practical knowledge of cloud and enterprise security environments, with an understanding of identity-related risks and security operations.
* Experience using Okta APIs, Terraform, infrastructure-as-code, automation, and CI/CD practices to manage IAM configurations and deployments.
* Ability to design scalable integrations and automate identity processes across SaaS, cloud, and on-premises environments.
* Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS.
